name: stochastic-parrot
title: stochastic-parrot
blurb: paste a handle: the page downloads their whole repo and trains a language model on their posts right in the tab. one linear layer and one softmax by default, with optional hidden layers, longer context and a bigger vocabulary for a smarter, slower parrot. you get a parrot score, a loss histogram, and a bsky-style thread to talk to it. asked for by @shimmermathlabs.com.
